userMessage:
Chcem ukázať ten istý verš v dvoch jazykoch pre našich anglicky hovoriacich hostí. Sprac do biblickej prezentácie:

##Ján 3:16## po slovensky (SEB): Veď Boh tak miloval svet, že dal svojho jednorodeného Syna, aby nezahynul nik, kto v neho verí, ale mal večný život.

##Ján 3:16## in English (KJV): For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

setup.description: Same verse (Ján 3:16 / John 3:16), same verse NUMBER, but two different translations back to back — SEB then KJV. compose_bible_items_into_slides forces a slide break on a translation change even when book/chapter/verse-number are identical (state/slides/compose.rs: 'Translation / book / chapter change forces a slide break'), so this must NOT collapse into one slide or get merged by the same-verse-number continuation logic (which only merges items sharing the SAME translation).

verbatimVerses.text: Veď Boh tak miloval svet, že dal svojho jednorodeného Syna, aby nezahynul nik, kto v neho verí, ale mal večný život.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

expected.notes: Hard-case category: multi-translation. Two load_bible_verses calls with different translation codes for the same book/chapter/verse. The two verse items must carry translation: 'SEB' and translation: 'KJV' respectively so the composer's group-change break fires, producing two slides even though the verse number (16) repeats — this specifically exercises the part of compose.rs NOT covered by ba-03 (which varies chapter/verse only, never translation).
